newsitem.title: USA: Oil service stocks rise after Bear Stearns upgrade.
newsitem.headline: Oil service stocks rise after Bear Stearns upgrade.

text.p: Shares of oil service companies moved higher on Thursday after a Bear Stearns analyst raised his ratings on a handful of drilling-related stocks.
The gains were part of a broad surge by energy issues, which have begun to rebound this week from a January sell-off that was triggered by concerns over lower oil prices.
Schlumberger Ltd rose 1-3/4 to 107-3/4, Halliburton Co gained 1-1/2 to 68-3/8, Varco International Inc jumped 1-1/4 to 25-7/8, and Reading & Bates Corp added 1-1/2 to 27-3/8.
All four stocks were upgraded by a Bear Stearns analyst Russell Hoffman.
With worries over oil prices abated, some investors have spotted a buying opportunity, analysts said. The Standard & Poor's Drilling Index was up nearly 1.5 percent at midday.

A successful federal auction of drilling rights in the Gulf of Mexico, held yesterday in New Orleans, also helped lift the sector, analysts said. The record-setting sale signaled strong demand for rigs, drilling equipment and crews in the Gulf, particularly in shallow-water tracts.
